name: Muñogalindo (Spain)
description: Red field with a white triangle from the hoist to the centre bearing a white house, the fly with a white chevron pointing to the fly.
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 7 March 2001 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 66 of 2 April 2001); the flag is rectangular of 2:3, a red cloth with a white triangle whose vertices lie at the ends of the staff and the centre of the flag.

features.role: triangle from the hoist to the centre
